 These 40+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (October 26-31) 
 The final week of the month
 by Fraser Gilbert 
 Sat, 1pm 
 Share:
 Image: The Last Case (October 29) Welcome to your Xbox games roundup for October 26-31 ! We've actually got a lot of releases over the next few days including Croc 2, The Wolf Among Us Remastered and a pair of free next-gen upgrades for the Metro Redux series, while Xbox Game Pass is treating us to no less than six games before the month is out!
 Here's what's coming to Xbox next week:
 On this page: These 40+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (October 26-31) 
 1. New Xbox Releases (October 26-31) 
 2. Xbox Game Pass Titles 
 New Xbox Releases (October 26-31)
 Ayasa: Shadows of Silence (October 26): "Step into the eerie world of Ayasa , a dark tale that blends quests, horror, and puzzles into a haunting journey."
 PAO PAO (October 26): "Meet quirky characters, discover cozy little spots and landmarks, gather resources in the wild, or simply wander around and see what’s happening."
 Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) (October 26): "Welcome to Scramble Knights Online, an MMO-lite adventure! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracott!"
 Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services (October 27): "Whether you’re curled up with a podcast or just need something peaceful to help the world feel quieter, this gentle 2D pressure washing game is here for you."
 Bloom Busters (October 27): "Bloom Busters is a frantic, old-school action arcade adventure with a distinctive isometric perspective. Play solo or team up in two-player local co-op..."
 Cozy Radiation Cleaner (October 27): "Cozy Radiation Cleaner is a relaxing open-world clean-up adventure set in a quiet, abandoned wasteland."
 Dog Man: Bark in Action (October 27): "Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets."
 Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Edition (October 27): "Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Edition bundles both the acclaimed main game and the Beans & Alpacas Expansion."
 Remothered: Nun's Legacy (October 27): "Your daughter has been kidnapped. In the trilogy’s final chapter, enter a nightmare to save her, survive what hunts you, and uncover the Red Nun’s truth through retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation."
 Sneaky Purr (October 27): "Control Bill, a mischievous cat and expert little thief, and help him steal all the food pouches before making his way back to the exit of each level."
 The Séance of Blake Manor (October 27): "Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions."
 Treasure Tiger (October 27): "You’ve got five nights to strike it rich and save your future. All you have to do is spin, survive, and keep the windows shut."
 Fall Adventure (October 28): "Fall Adventure is a 2D pixel art platformer where you must find all the magical orbs to progress."
 Fallen City Brawl (October 28): "Brawl through the city in hard-hitting pixel art style inspired by arcade classics! As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City’s criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets!"
 Gennady (October 28): "The blinding light fades, revealing a grim alien meat factory where you must break through compressed biomass with your own body — not to pay the fare, but to survive!"
 House Builder 2 (October 28): "In House Builder 2, you build your dream structures in a vibrant, open-world low-poly environment!"
 Karate Survivor (October 28): "Step into the shoes of a martial arts master in a thrilling survival-like roguelite inspired by action movies of the ‘80s."
 Platypus Steps (October 28): "Get ready for an adventure full of creativity and strategy in Platypus Steps! Help an adorable baby platypus reach the cookie jar by carefully planning the path it needs to follow."
 Primal Planet (October 28): "Primal Planet is a solo developed metroidvania that combines survival and crafting elements with a pixel-perfect aesthetic and an action-packed story, and it’s all taking place on a lush planet filled with dinosaurs."
 Sno: Ultimate Freeriding (October 28): "SNØ is a downhill skiing game with a simple design that pursues the pure joy of carving through snow. Carve your way down procedurally generated mountainscapes, pull off high-risk proximity tricks and thrilling maneuvers, and aim for the high score."
 SULFUR (October 28): "SULFUR is a roguelike FPS with fast-paced gunplay, cooking mechanics, and hard choices. Explore hostile zones, fight unpredictable enemies, and loot everything in your power."
 Beyond The Evil (October 29): "Get ready for an immersive experience of mystery and suspense. In Beyond The Evil, you take on the role of Detective Gary Nephew during one of the most unsettling investigations of his career."
 Candy Shop Simulator (October 29): "Step into the sweet world of confectionery and build the candy shop of your dreams! Create delicious pastries, chocolates, gummies, and other tasty treats, then stock your shelves and welcome eager customers."
 Choice of Life: Floors (October 29): "Use the items you find, fight the creatures of your mind, embrace the absurdity of your situation, and decide: will you escape this nightmare, or drown in it forever?"
 Choice of Life: Samosbor (October 29): "The gray concrete walls of the living cell, closing the hermetic door at the sound of a siren - all this is commonplace in Gigastructure. Everything here goes its way, until the block is isolated in search of a secret object..."
 Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos (October 29): "Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos is the sequel to the multi-million selling classic, Croc Legend of the Gobbos."
 Curse of Resthaven (October 29): "Curse of Resthaven is a single-player narrative roguelite where investigation, town management, trading, deck building, and branching expeditions combine into a dark mystery of survival and consequence."
 HELLBOUND INC (October 29): "HELLBOUND INC is a rage-inducing precision platformer where you play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently purchased by Satan himself."
 Hunting Simulator 3 (October 29): "Either on foot or behind the wheel of your all-terrain vehicle, explore this open world's stunning environments. Set off to deepest Colorado, or untamed outback of Texas, each with dozens of wild species to hunt."
 HYPERVIOLENT (October 29): "HYPERVIOLENT is a brutal, old-school FPS in the style of classic sprite-based 3D games from the 1990s – but think more System Shock, less DOOM."
 Joe & Mac Retro Collection (October 29): "Grab your hammer, the Stone Age is back and bigger than ever! For the first time, three legendary adventures from the Joe & Mac universe are united in a single collection."
 Love: Fall in Death (October 29): "An FMV interactive romantic comedy where your choices, timing, and luck shape every scene."
 Metro Redux Next-Gen Upgrades (October 29): "Players on console can experience true 4K at 60FPS and upscaled 4K at 120FPS (with the right monitor or TV hardware), higher quality lighting, shadows and particle effects."
 Mouthwashing (October 29): "Mouthwashing is a first-person horror game following the dying crew of a shipwrecked space freighter."
 Planted! (October 29): "Planted! is a horticultural combat party game where gardens are arenas, plants become weapons, and the gap between “tending your crops” and “launching them at your opponents” is smaller than you’d think."
 Souls of Bombarika (October 29): "Possess everyday objects, outsmart an evil witch, and solve explosive puzzles in this quirky supernatural adventure."
 The Last Case (October 29): "Step into the shoes of a police officer investigating the mysterious disappearance of children. Enter the twisted world of a dangerous mind and uncover the truth."
 The Transference (October 29): "The Transference is a first-person narrative escape-room thriller set in northern Andalusia, Spain, in the late 1990s."
 The Wolf Among Us Remastered (October 29): "Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered – the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series."
 The Zibbo Show (October 29): "Progress through 12 rounds of increasingly dangerous opponents, build a new strategy every run, and face Zibbo himself in the in the grand finale!"
 Terrible Lizards (October 29): "It’s 1992. No cell phones. No rideshares. No help coming, and you’ll soon find that you are not alone inside the attraction."
 Train Yard Builder (October 29): "Enter the world of Train Yard Builder and customize your railway to your heart's content. Work with different models of trains and wagons, control them the way you want, and use modeler tools to unleash your creativity."
 Asylum (October 30): "ASYLUM is an ambitious first-person horror adventure casting you into the hallucinatory setting of the Hanwell Mental Institute."
 Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares (October 30): "Inspired by 1999 golden-era classics like Spyro the Dragon, MediEvil, and Crash Bandicoot, this solo-developed passion project brings back the tight movement and low-poly gothic charm you thought was lost forever."
 Cat Pipes: More Meow (October 30): "Cat Pipes: More Meow is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game about guiding warmth to sleepy cats."
 Corner Shop: NightShift (October 30): "Corner Shop: Nightshift is a first-person narrative horror sim set in a failing convenience store. Play as Adam Callahan and try to put your life back together."
 Ex-Master, Zombie (October 30): "You are a zombie, risen from the grave to reclaim what was lost. At first, you are only a head, but with each found body fragment, forgotten skills, strength, and the true nature of the Ex-Master return."
 Love Love Mystery Club (October 30): "Love Love Mystery Club is an immersive horror-dating simulator set in a Thai high school. You play as a young student who one day starts to see spirits and decides to join the occult club."
 My Life: Zoo Vet (October 30): "Many exciting tasks await you in the zoo, and some of the cute residents need your help. From clumsy young animals to curious penguins and powerful elephants - they all need nursing back to health!"
 Pinballoid Crush (October 30): "In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements."
 Queen's Domain (October 30): "Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle."
 Space Rock Breaker (October 30): "Space Rock Breaker is a short incremental game about mining asteroids in space. Mine asteroids with guns, unlock new materials, process the ore by dropping it into a Plinko machine, and spend your credits on upgrades in a massive skill tree."
 The Abjuration Stand (October 30): "Fast 2D tower defense and survival game. You play a small wizard who holds the line while green slimes and other monsters flood the path."
 The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem (October 30): "Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 & Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride."
 The Night of the Exorcism (October 30): "The devils inside Isabella will not be removed easily. Navigate the seven creatures that hold her life in her hands, and find a way to expel them one by one – or succumb to their temptations."
 Horrorvale (October 31): "Your next-door neighbors are zombies, reanimated monsters deliver the mail and ghosts hide out in your bathroom. Don't worry about anybody you kill along the way–-everyone is already dead! Muahahha!"
